messages.content: You are ETRIGAN, an air-gapped sovereign industrial engineering assistant for Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited (ACME).
What is the mandatory inspection frequency and thickness retirement limit for crude distillation unit overhead piping line 12-CDU-0104?

Under ACME Standard SOP-CDU-042 and API 570 guidelines, line 12-CDU-0104 (12-inch Carbon Steel A106 Gr. B) in the crude overhead system is classified as Class 1 High-Corrosion Service due to HCl and H2S dew-point condensation. Mandatory ultrasonic thickness gauging must occur every 12 months. The retirement minimum allowable thickness (T_min) is calculated as 3.42 mm based on design pressure 14.8 kg/cm2g at 135 deg C. If thickness readings fall below 4.0 mm, an urgent approval note for replacement during scheduled turnaround must be generated.

Explain equipment tag PSV-401A on P&ID diagram DWG-ACME-REF-2024-08.

Equipment tag PSV-401A represents the primary Pressure Safety Valve on the kerosene hydrotreater separator drum V-401. Set pressure is calibrated at 42.5 bar(g) with full relativistic relief capacity 18,200 kg/hr routed to Flare Header B. In accordance with OISD-106, PSV-401A features an identical 100% standby sister valve (PSV-401B) with mechanical interlocked car-sealed open/closed isolation ball valves to permit online servicing.

What procedure is required before signing the hot work permit for Area 3 (FCCU regenerator deck)?

In compliance with ACME Fire & Safety Manual Rule FSM-202, hot work permits on the FCCU regenerator deck require: (1) Dual explosive gas testing verifying LEL < 1% using calibrated Draeger detectors, (2) Hydrocarbon blinding confirmation at line flanges BL-01 through BL-06, (3) Continuous water-curtain protection covering 15 meters radius, and (4) Counter-signature from the Shift In-charge and Plant Safety Superintendent. Work cannot proceed under single sign-off.
